title: RoleBreak: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Role-Playing Robustness in Spoken Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2609.16614v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech-to-speech dialogue models increasingly support persona control, yet existing spoken role-playing benchmarks remain largely character-centric and short-horizon. This leaves open whether spoken dialogue models can sustain diverse roles over extended interactions, especially beyond predefined fictional characters. We introduce RoleBreak, an open benchmark for long-horizon role-playing robustness in spoken dialogue. RoleBreak contains 310 character-based and user-centered roles, 6,688 human-verified dialogue turns, and 11,743 fine-grained evaluation criteria, with 1,856 turns carrying expressive emotion targets for evaluating vocal emotion. Its scenarios are designed to stress role consistency, interaction quality, safety, and affect over extended conversations. translated_title: RoleBreak：口语对话中长时程角色扮演鲁棒性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 语音到语音对话模型日益支持人设控制，然而现有的口语角色扮演基准大多以角色为中心且时长较短。这使得口语对话模型能否在长时间交互中维持多样化角色——尤其是超越预定义虚构角色之外——仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们提出了RoleBreak，一个面向口语对话中长时程角色扮演鲁棒性的开放基准。RoleBreak包含310个基于角色和以用户为中心的角色、6,688条经人工验证的对话轮次，以及11,743条细粒度评估标准，其中1,856个轮次带有表达性情感目标，用于评估语音情感。其场景设计旨在考察长对话中的角色一致性、交互质量、安全性与情感表现。我们评估了涵盖全双工、全模态以及级联式ASR-LLM-TTS范式的九种配置，并发现了四个关键模式。首先，当前系统在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了RoleBreak——一个面向口语对话中长时程角色扮演鲁棒性的开放基准，包含310个角色、6,688条人工验证对话轮次和11,743条细粒度评估标准，系统评估了九种语音对话系统在角色一致性、交互质量、安全性和情感表达上的表现。
en_tdlr: RoleBreak is an open benchmark for long-horizon role-playing robustness in spoken dialogue, featuring 310 roles, 6,688 human-verified dialogue turns, and 11,743 fine-grained evaluation criteria to assess role consistency, interaction quality, safety, and affect across nine full-duplex, omni-modal, and cascaded ASR-LLM-TTS system configurations.
